elements.name: q_1
elements.title: When does WCAG require a correct reading sequence?
choices: For every visual position regardless of meaning

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: What can CSS visual reordering leave unchanged?

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: How can you investigate reading order?
choices: Read the DOM sequence with a screen reader

answer_key.q_3: Read the DOM sequence with a screen reader

explanations.q_1: A correct programmatic sequence is required when order affects meaning.
explanations.q_2: Visual layout can change while DOM order stays the same.
explanations.q_3: Reading the source sequence helps reveal order problems.
